key_reasoning.reason: Diff spans health-controller.js (orchestration), health-ui.js (presentation), doctor-parse.js/doctor-groups.js (parsing/grouping), the shared failure-panel.js component, renderer.js (core app shell wiring/view routing) and the Rust logger.rs command — five-plus components, several of them shared/core rather than local to Health, so Component Scope bumps from L to XL under the 'touches core shared utilities' red flag.
diffstat reports 14 files changed across 4 directories (src-tauri/src/commands, ui/, ui/test/, ui/test/fixtures/doctor/), which maps to the 11-15 XL band in the File Change Estimate mapping.

Inline CR-003 through CR-008 comments in health-controller.js and health-ui.js document several edge cases (double-run guard, stuck-loading recovery, zero-record false all-clear, log-error banner surviving a recheck) that were clearly discovered and fixed during implementation rather than specified up front.

No exact precedent existed for the doctor-run stream -> parse -> group -> render pipeline's failure modes (empty output, mid-run rejection, race between recheck and a pending log-open); each was handled defensively, but the surrounding Health screen pattern (existing before this diff) kept the risk from reaching L.
